description: If YOUR wallet has been unfairly reported, attach a signed rebuttal that appears alongside the reports in every reputation lookup. Prove you control the wallet by signing the exact message 'tollwarden-dispute-v1|<your address, lowercase>|<statement>' with the wallet's key (EIP-191 personal_sign) and passing the 65-byte signature hex. Rebuttals never erase reports — agents see both sides. Free.

address.description: The reported wallet address (0x…, the one that signed)

statement.description: Your side of the story — exactly the text that was signed

name: dispute_reputation
